explainer.summary: How the bot works — in plain words
explainer.what: What it buys. {assets} — large, liquid cryptocurrencies. The capital is split equally between them, and every coin gets its own trend signal.
explainer.how: How it decides. Once a day, after the daily close (00:00 UTC), the bot compares the price with its average over 20, 50, 100 and 200 days. Price above all four averages means the market is rising, so the bot holds the coin. Below all of them means the market is falling, so the bot sells it and waits in USDT. Mixed signals — it holds a part.
explainer.trades: How many trades. Few — usually several a month. The exchange charges about 0.1% per trade; it is already included in the result.
explainer.history: What happened in the past. From 2018 to 2026 this approach on Bitcoin and Ethereum returned about +42% a year on average versus +23% for simple buy-and-hold. But there were hard periods: the capital temporarily fell almost by half, and in 2018 and 2022 the bot lost 25–30% a year. Past results do not guarantee future results.
explainer.autostop: Auto-protection. When starting you can choose a threshold: if the capital falls below it, the bot sells everything and stops. Too strict a threshold may stop the bot during an ordinary temporary drawdown after which the market would have recovered.
explainer.solana: Solana. The bot can trade on the Solana blockchain instead of Binance: it swaps USDC for cbBTC, WETH or SOL through the Jupiter aggregator, which finds the best rate across all decentralized exchanges on the network. The money stays in your wallet — no exchange account is needed. The simulation uses real Jupiter quotes but sends no transactions. When the decision journal is on, every daily decision is written to the blockchain before trading — it can't be changed retroactively.
explainer.otherMoney: Your other money. In real mode the bot manages only the amount you gave it and the coins it bought itself. It doesn't touch the rest of the funds on your Binance account or in your wallet.
footer: This is an automated trading program, not investment advice.
